sanskrit: pituṃ nu stoṣaṃ maho dharmāṇaṃ taviṣīm | yasya trito vy ojasā vṛtraṃ viparvam ardayat ||
english: Now I will praise the drink, great in ordinance, mighty in strength — he at whose impelling power Trita, with his might, shattered Vṛtra joint from joint.

sanskrit: svādo pito madho pito vayaṃ tvā vavṛmahe | asmākam avitā bhava ||
english: O sweet food, O honeyed food, we have chosen thee; be thou our protector.

sanskrit: upa naḥ pitav ā gahi śivaḥ śivābhir ūtibhiḥ | mayobhūr adviṣeṇyaḥ sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ ||
english: Come to us, O food, auspicious with auspicious aids; be thou a fount of joy, free from enmity, a friend, most gracious — be such for us.

sanskrit: tava tye pito rasā rajāṃsy anu viṣṭhitāḥ | divi vātā iva śritāḥ ||
english: Thy flavors, O food, are spread abroad through the realms, abiding in heaven like the winds.

sanskrit: tava tye pito dadatas tava svādiṣṭha te pito | pra svādmāno rasānāṃ tuvigrīvā iverate ||
english: Thine are those who give, O food; thine are the sweetest, O food — they who are full of the sweetness of thy flavors rush forward like bulls with mighty necks.

sanskrit: tve pito mahānāṃ devānāṃ mano hitam | akāri cāru ketunā tavāhim avasāvadhīt ||
english: In thee, O food, the mind of the great gods is set; by thine ensign a beautiful act was wrought — he smote the serpent in his lair.

sanskrit: yad adaḥ pito ajagan vivasva parvatānām | atrā cin no madho pito 'raṃ bhakṣāya gamyāḥ ||
english: When thou, O food, didst travel to yonder luminous realm of the mountains, there too, O honeyed food, do thou come rightly for our partaking.

sanskrit: yat te soma gavāśiro yavāśiro bhajāmahe | vātāpe pīva id bhava ||
english: What of thee, O Soma, mixed with milk of cows, mixed with barley, we partake of — Vātāpa, be thou fat indeed.

sanskrit: yad apām oṣadhīnāṃ pariṃśam āriśāmahe (…) ||
english: Whatever remnant of waters and of herbs we eat of — [Vātāpa, be thou fat indeed].

sanskrit: karambha oṣadhe bhava pīvo vṛkka udārathiḥ | vātāpe pīva id bhava ||
english: O karambha-gruel, be a herb; be fat, O belly, freely moving — Vātāpa, be thou fat indeed.

sanskrit: taṃ tvā vayaṃ pito vacobhir gāvo na havyā suṣūdima | asmabhyaṃ tvā sadhamādaṃ devebhyas tvā sadhamādam ||
english: Thee, O food, we have made to flow sweetly with our hymns as cows their oblation — thee for our communal joy, thee for the communal joy of the gods.

sanskrit: prati tyaṃ cārum adhvaraṃ gopīthāya pra hūyase | marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
english: Toward that fair sacrifice thou art invoked for its keeping; come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

sanskrit: nahi devo na martyo mahas tava kratuṃ paraḥ (…) ||
english: No god and no mortal surpasses the greatness of thy will — [come, O Agni, with the Maruts].

sanskrit: ye maho rajaso vidur viśve devāso adruhaḥ (…) ||
english: They who know the great realm of space, all the gods, free from deceit — [come, O Agni, with the Maruts].

sanskrit: ye śubhrā ghoravarpasaḥ sukṣatrāso riśādasaḥ (…) ||
english: They who are bright, of terrible form, of good dominion, devourers of the adversary — [come, O Agni, with the Maruts].

sanskrit: ya ugrā arkam ānṛcur anādhṛṣṭāsa ojasā (…) ||
english: They who, fierce, have chanted the hymn, irresistible in their might — [come, O Agni, with the Maruts].

sanskrit: ye nākasyādhi rocane divi devāsa āsate (…) ||
english: They who, divine, are seated in the shining vault upon the sky's surface — [come, O Agni, with the Maruts].

sanskrit: ya īṅkhayanti parvatān tiraḥ samudram ojasā (…) ||
english: They who shake the mountains across the ocean with their might — [come, O Agni, with the Maruts].

sanskrit: ā ye tanvanti raśmibhis tiraḥ samudram arṇavam (…) ||
english: They who stretch out with their rays across the billowing ocean — [come, O Agni, with the Maruts].

sanskrit: abhi tvā pūrvapītaye sṛjāmi somyaṃ madhu (…) ||
english: I release toward thee the Soma-sweet honey for the first drinking — [come, O Agni, with the Maruts].

sanskrit: ā yantu maruto gaṇai stutā dadhatu no rayim (…) ||
english: Let the Maruts come in their troops, praised; let them bestow wealth upon us — [come, O Agni, with the Maruts].

sanskrit: ā tvā kaṇvā ahūṣata gṛṇanti vipra te dhiyaḥ | marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
english: The Kaṇvas have called to thee; they praise, O inspired one, thy thoughts — come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

sanskrit: saṃ mā siñcantu marutaḥ saṃ pūṣā saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | saṃ māyam agniḥ siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca dīrgham āyuṣ kṛṇotu me ||
english: May the Maruts pour together upon me, may Pūṣan, may Bṛhaspati; may this Agni pour together upon me with progeny and with wealth — may he make for me a long life-span.

sanskrit: (…) siñcantv ādityāḥ saṃ mā siñcantv agnayaḥ | indraḥ sam asmān siñcatu (…) ||
english: May the Ādityas pour together, may the Agnis pour together upon me; may Indra pour together upon us — [with progeny and with wealth, may he make for me a long life-span].

sanskrit: (…) siñcantv aruṣāḥ sam arkā ṛṣayaś ca ye | pūṣā sam (…) ||
english: May the ruddy ones pour together, and the hymns and whatsoever sages; may Pūṣan pour together — [with progeny and with wealth, may he make for me a long life-span].

sanskrit: (…) siñcantu gandharvāpsarasaḥ saṃ mā siñcantu devatāḥ | bhagaḥ sam (…) ||
english: May the Gandharvas and the Apsarasas pour together; may the divinities pour together upon me; may Bhaga pour together — [with progeny and with wealth, may he make for me a long life-span].

sanskrit: (…) siñcantu pṛthivīḥ saṃ mā siñcantu yā divaḥ | antarikṣaṃ sam (…) ||
english: May the earths pour together; may those of heaven pour together upon me; may the atmosphere pour together — [with progeny and with wealth, may he make for me a long life-span].

sanskrit: (…) siñcantu pradiśaḥ saṃ mā siñcantu yā diśaḥ | āśā sam (…) ||
english: May the intermediate quarters pour together; may the directions pour together upon me; may the expanse pour together — [with progeny and with wealth, may he make for me a long life-span].

sanskrit: (…) siñcantu nadyaḥ saṃ mā siñcantu sindhavaḥ | samudraḥ sam (…) ||
english: May the rivers pour together; may the sindhu-streams pour together upon me; may the ocean pour together — [with progeny and with wealth, may he make for me a long life-span].

sanskrit: (…) siñcantu kṛṣayaḥ saṃ mā siñcantv oṣadhīḥ | somaḥ sam (…) ||
english: May the ploughed fields pour together; may the herbs pour together upon me; may Soma pour together — [with progeny and with wealth, may he make for me a long life-span].

sanskrit: saṃ mā siñcantu yā āpaḥ saṃ mā siñcantu vṛṣṭayaḥ | sarasvatī sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca dīrgham āyuṣ kṛṇotu me ||
english: May the waters pour together upon me; may the rains pour together upon me; may Sarasvatī pour together upon us with progeny and with wealth — may she make for me a long life-span.
